description:
Outcome: gardeners sign in to their own household and coordinator accesses privileged functions, from owner sign-in answer and brief.md Constraints.
Scope: emailed short-lived single-use links; signed sessions/logout; replay protection/rate limits/safe redirects; coordinator provisioning; server/API record authorization and roster binding. Excludes: passwords, social login and self-service household merging.
Acceptance: intended recipient gets own records only; coordinator alone sees other households/contact details; expired/used links denied with resend; unknown emails receive non-enumerating response and enrollment help; submitted IDs never elevate privileges.
Behaviour: email failures recoverable, accessible feedback, token-safe logs.
Verification: replay/expiry/session/cross-household integration tests and sandbox mail. Prerequisites: foundation, prototype checkpoint and records. Assumptions: one sign-in email per household; coordinator enrolls households.
title: Passwordless access and roles
